agents.name: Stephen Ring
agents.shortBio: 32 years in real estate, 1500+ solo transactions, and a quietly held reputation as one of South Australia's elite agents.
bio: Stephen has been in real estate for 32 years.

He has a natural energy for his working-passion that comes from – integrity, moral values and ethics, and an innate understanding of the real estate transaction. Stephen's consistent performance through his career is unrivalled – when you value your work and believe in how you deliver it time-after-time – experience fosters great knowledge and a template for success. His performance builds clients-for-life and a referral network that takes his talent all over metro-Adelaide.

Stephen is a master negotiator and is fascinated with the psychology of selling and buying real estate – for 5 years, he taught Price Range Marketing and Negotiation to Agents around Australia. He is a professional consultant in all areas of real estate – and with more than 1500 solo transactions, Stephen is one of SA's elite agents.

Stephen studies the real estate industry and understands the economics. Real Estate markets are not constant, they are always evolving and changing, and often mis-reported. No matter the market – through three decades, Stephen has been able to perform for his clients and safeguard their best interests.

In 2006 and 2007 he was Metropolitan Sales Person of the year and in 2009 was nominated as finalist for the South Australian Sales Person of the year. He has also held the position of number 1 Sales Person in a network group of over 500 salespeople around Australia.
With a wonderful history and a deep respect for core values – as a Principal Director, Stephen is proud of his team and is focused on an exciting future of growth. Join Stephen on the journey.

agents.name: Luke Bull
agents.shortBio: Bachelor of Business (Property), mentored by Stephen Ring, focused on accurate appraisals and great support for sellers and buyers.
bio: Luke is a talent. At the age of 15, Luke met Stephen Ring at an open-home with his family and immediately knew he was destined for a real estate career. Through his clear focus and dedication to earn the grades that would take him to University, Luke, now 22, holds the ultimate qualification in real estate – Bachelor of Business, with a major in Property.
In 2023, while completing studies, Luke commenced his career in real estate. In that time, he has been involved with administration, property management and sales support.

In 2024, he has become immersed in the science of valuing real estate, working directly with Stephen Ring delivering appraisal-strategy advice, and providing great support to sellers and buyers through the sale process.

Luke is a driven young man with a calm and professional demeanour beyond his years. With his education behind him and an ongoing mentorship through Stephen Ring – he now has his sights set on a successful career.

Luke is already impressing with an innate understanding of what it takes to deliver a successful real estate transaction. He is qualified and has the skills to interpret the data to value real estate correctly, he works with Stephen to tailor selling-strategies that will bring success, he is clever with marketing and promotion, and buyers simply love interacting with Luke.
If you need an accurate assessment of Market Value on your property, or if you are buying and want some upfront support and guidance – get in touch with Luke.

agents.name: Soozie Bice
agents.shortBio: 20 years with Ring, decades in real estate, and a hands-on approach to caring for your home and investment.
bio: Soozie lives life with an infectious energy and an endearing quality. She involves herself completely in whatever she puts her mind to – and succeeds. Soozie loves to keep busy and devotes her time to a project with a sense of wholeness and a commitment to the task – in her own way, she has the unique ability to promote the opportunity before her and brings a natural feeling of goodwill to the process.

Soozie has been working in real estate since the 80s, and for 20 years she has been a loyal and integral part of the Ring team. Soozie enjoyed a successful sales career, both in her own right and in a supporting role with John Ring and Stephen Ring, and for the last 5 years has been working in specialist property management.

In renting and caring for your home and investment, Soozie's attention and hands-on approach to getting things done the right way is incredible. Her huge experience provides the unique ability to see things others don't, she aims to secure the right tenant every time, and then builds relationships and trust that ensure a peaceful and smooth tenancy.

Living in Blackwood for most of her life, Soozie involves herself in all things community – the Blackwood Golf Club's social and sponsorship committee, the Pennant Team on the golf course, and volunteer work with the State Emergency Services (SES), for which she received a Premier's Award for Officer and Community Engagement.
Soozie is an inspiring Mum to three boys, now men succeeding in their own lives. For total peace-of-mind in property management, look no further.

agents.name: Rachel Brooke
agents.shortBio: 16 years' experience, 9 of them with Ring – organised, intuitive, and quietly excellent at managing investment properties.
bio: Rachel is simply very good at what she does. With 16 years of experience, she understands Property Management inside-out. Behind the scenes, Rachel is in the office at 8.00am – she loves the hour without interruption where she can plan and get things done for clients.

Professional management of a rental portfolio means being organised, disciplined and ahead of the game; it requires a certain intuition that only comes from a high level of care and experience – where each and every client is rewarded with a valuable and personalised service that provides ultimate peace-of-mind.

Rachel's early learnings came from working within the family business. Her father owned a successful real estate company in Adelaide, built on traditional family values where they forged a trusted reputation and a loyal client base. Rachel joined the Ring team 9 years ago, and it is her collective experience and sound values that make her a valued member of the team.

Rachel is all about safeguarding your best interests and ensuring a seamless tenancy. Thanks to Rachel's work and her relationships with tenants, many of our clients have excellent long-term tenancies and extremely well-cared-for properties.

Always ensuring her management expertise is up-to-date, Rachel prefers to go about her work in an unassuming manner – and with a practical, sensible and a caring approach. With two beautiful children, her life away from work is all about family. If you want your home or investment managed properly, trust in Rachel.

agents.name: Toni Dalcin
agents.shortBio: Trust accounting, financial planning and the warm welcome that holds the office together day-to-day.
bio: Toni works in the critical area of Trust Accounting and financial planning & control, reporting to our Accountancy Firm and our Principal Director, Stephen Ring.

In a real estate business, there are many financial transactions through sales and property management to our reliable trades and business partners. Toni is fastidious in her work and reporting, and her attention to detail in all areas of the day-to-day financial side of a business is valuable.

Toni collaborates with essential Business Partners to ensure their resources and services get to our team in an efficient way. She will welcome you on the phone or in person in the office, her care and skills extend with support to Property Management, and she has a flair for assisting the sales team in delivering marketing and promotion.

In Administration, Toni works closely with Fiona, and together they provide a valuable contribution to the business. They are an amazing support to the Sales and Rental teams, and their communications with clients and customers are beyond reproach.

listings.headline: 60's Contemporary in a Position-Perfect Setting
description: Tucked into one of the most sought-after pockets of Glenalta–Belair, this mid-century home offers a lifestyle that beautifully balances peace, nature, and connection.

Enjoy leisurely walks through leafy streets and nearby reserves, with the sanctuary of Belair National Park just around the corner. Blackwood’s shopping precinct is an easy drive, Stirling Village is just 15 minutes up the road, and a scenic descent connects you to Sensational Adelaide.

The land measures 920sqm, and the backyard is nothing short of a dream. With expansive lawn areas and established, park-like gardens, the space feels far larger than its footprint—open, private, and where you don’t feel closed-in! It’s the perfect setting for a young or growing family, with plenty of room for play, weekends at home, and the family hound will love you for it.

Held and cherished by one family for many years, the home is ready to begin its next chapter. Its mid-century character reflects the architectural soul of the area, presented beautifully and all set for immediate enjoyment, while offering exciting scope to add your own style and vision over time.

Large windows frame a lush front garden outlook, bringing a sense of tranquillity into everyday living, while a late 80s studio-style extension with its vaulted windows captures the beauty of the backyard and blends seamlessly with the original dwelling – 1 Menura Avenue simply feels like home.

• A concrete driveway leads to a carport designed to accommodate two vehicles in tandem and provides sheltered access into the home. For visitors, an atrium-style formal entry, complete with a cloakroom, creates a warm and inviting first impression.

listings.headline: A Truly Wonderful Home
description: Cherished by one family since 1984, this much-loved residence is offered to the market for the very first time and is now ready to welcome its next chapter.

Immaculately presented both inside and out, it offers an exceptional opportunity to secure a home in one of the most sought-after and tightly held pockets of Bellevue Heights – complete with an elevated backyard aspect and captivating views.

Privately sited from the street on a beautiful 940sqm of land, the home enjoys the very best in outdoor living that enhances its sense of seclusion and tranquillity. From the upper-level parent retreat and alfresco balcony, as well as the expansive outdoor living zone below, you’ll enjoy sweeping outlooks and a seamless connection to beautiful gardens and surrounding greenery.

Designed for relaxed family living and effortless entertaining, this home offers a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The expansive outdoor living area spans the entire length of the home, functioning as a true extension of the interior – perfect for year-round enjoyment. Whether you're hosting gatherings, unwinding with sport on the TV, or enjoying yoga in a peaceful setting, this great space connects with greenery and distant views, all while maintaining complete privacy.

The front garden showcases a distinctive Mediterranean influence, with beautifully established terraced landscaping framed by natural stone retaining walls. A sunken alfresco courtyard and gentle water feature create a serene setting that flows effortlessly into the home’s main living areas.

Inside, every detail has been lovingly maintained – this is a home in pristine condition where you can simply move in and start living. A gently sloping concrete driveway leads to a huge high-clearance carport, accommodating up to three vehicles or two cars plus a camper trailer with ease.

listings.headline: Spacious Family Living with Dual Residence Potential in Leafy Glenalta
description: Set in a sought-after position where that secluded feeling is also very convenient, this substantial home offers a lifestyle of space, privacy and flexibility on a beautiful 2260sqm (0.55acre) allotment. The land sweeps the corner of Gannet Avenue and its private cul-de-sac which provides access to the home and its backyard setting where there is abundant potential!

16 Gannet Avenue has been a home to a growing family for some time, they have loved their place and the lifestyle it has afforded, especially being close to Blackwood Village shopping, our famous Belair Hotel, popular schools, and the train to Adelaide. Nature lovers will appreciate living connected to local reserves that offer walking trails, exercise and family fun, while the proximity to Belair National Park will provide weekend adventures right on your doorstep.

Built in 1978 using superior construction methods rarely seen today, the home features solid brick and a suspended concrete floor between the levels delivering exceptional durability and living qualities – it promotes independent living on both levels! Designed to blend beautifully into its natural surroundings, the home offers generous and versatile accommodation ideal for growing or perhaps extended families.
A formal entrance is always welcoming and together with the hallway they serve to zone the bedrooms away from the living areas.

There are three well-sized bedrooms plus a study or 4th bedroom. All have a peaceful green outlook through windows. Two have built-in robes and ceiling fans, while the study has direct access to the balcony. They share a main bathroom and ideally a separate toilet.

A spacious lounge and the separate dining-family room have picture window’s that frame leafy outlooks to nature. They are both great size rooms! Bifold doors bring them together and keep them separated when they need to be – the family-dining room has solid hardwood parquetry flooring with access out to the long balcony, and a beautiful outlook to the backyard setting and treetops.

listings.headline: Here is Your Chance!
description: To secure a home and investment in your future and buy into beautiful Clarence Gardens.

Come and live with a perfect north facing backyard setting, and if a garage-workshop is on the wish-list – it doesn’t get much better than this. This 1960-character home lives on 835sqm of land with perfect dimensions and where the frontage is 19.82m.

Uniquely different in its own way, there is a certain understated quality about this home. The solid brick and stone construction together with stepped concrete walls and large bay window give this home its unique appeal, while on the inside, the home comes with a few quirky features and lots of potential!

Inside, there are high ceilings throughout, and all the rooms are spacious! The main living room features acoustic ceilings, the old combustion heater has a rare marble stone hearth and surround, hardwood timber mantel, bookshelves and a large mirror that amplifies this main living room. Another cool feature are the two timber and glass panelled sliding doors that keep this room private. Install a new wood-fired combustion heater in time for the winter season and cosy in!

Separate dining is a link room and complements both the main living area and the kitchen. The galley style Blackwood timber kitchen looks out through sash windows to the backyard setting, it has excellent storage and bench-space, there is a dishwasher, and room for a large fridge.

The wide formal entry and hallway also serve to zone the bedrooms from the two living areas making them feel private. The main bedroom also has acoustic ceilings and features timeless timber joinery and built-in storage. Bedroom two is a good-size room and together they share a classic terrazzo bathroom with a little life left and ideally a separate toilet. The laundry-utility room is accessed by the rear porch.

listings.headline: A Dream Family Home
description: In the heart of Blackwood on 1850sqm (0.46acre), what a lifestyle this is!
58 Brighton Parade was built by the current owners for their growing family in 1994 and presents in immaculate condition.

With a Homestead influence in style and its solid Bluestone façade, there is a certain character that is refreshing when compared to the modern home of recent times; and an undeniable quality with superior solid brick and concrete construction – imagine finding the land and building a home of this calibre today.

Harmonious to an idyllic foothills environment this beautiful home has been sited to take every advantage of an amazing parcel of land. There are no steps inside while outside the land is pretty-well flat – it measures 1850sqm and with perfect dimensions, it’s all useable and surprisingly low maintenance!

The position is superb. Enjoy a relaxed walk to our Blackwood Village and if work is in the city, you can leave the car at home at take the train at Coromandel Station. The children can get themselves to Blackwood High School or to the bus for a choice of private schools. The Blackwood Football Club is a fabulous community hub, and the walking-bike trails of the amazing Sturt Gorge Recreation Park are close.
Having two driveways that provide backyard access with exceptional garaging and work-shed areas is a big feature that can be hard to find.

listings.headline: Imagine Living Here...
description: Vacant land in Metro-Adelaide is like Gold, and 12 Cowell Crescent presents a huge opportunity to secure rare earth where you can build the dream! Think of coming home at the end of your day to peace & quiet and your own space on a beautiful 1196sqm.

The land is sited at the end of a cul-de-sac and rises from street level to provide an elevated aspect with a panorama of night lights, sea & sunset views. With a natural reserve along one boundary that divides neighbouring properties and open space reserve opposite; the land invites the opportunity to design a custom home that takes every advantage of this unique setting – a home here could be truly spectacular!
Think of building toward the back of the allotment, elevated off the ground with a terrace out the front and carparking under the home and imagine living with those views every day.
The location and position are superb – nestled into the Pasadena foothills with that feeling of disconnect and where Sensational Adelaide is on your doorstep.
• A drive to Brighton beach is 15-minutes, while getting to Adelaide City in 15-20 makes life easy!
• The amazing Pasadena shopping complex is down the road, and the all-new Hotel Panorama is just about complete.

listings.headline: A Relaxing Coastal Retreat... It's Time!
description: Open this coming weekend or during the week by Private Appointment. Please contact Stephen or Luke to arrange a viewing.

Imagine owing a peaceful escape where you will feel far from it all and yet be so connected – a drive from metro Adelaide is easy, our famous McLaren Vale and Willunga region is a part of the lifestyle, and the whole coastline too from Sellicks to Port Willunga.
This Esplanade position is idyllic. It’s a spot that almost only services its residents and doesn’t have the through traffic making it incredibly peaceful.
Sunsets light up the red cliffs of Cactus Canyon opposite and the views to the southwest sea and coastline seem to go on forever.

9 Esplanade offers an immediate lifestyle to be enjoyed; as a permanent home or treasure it as a place of retreat where you can really escape, all year round, and truly get away from it all. Share it as a popular holiday home and turn it into a flourishing investment and if you have eyes to the future – think of building a second storey and take it to whole new level! The current owner did and has plans that will provide the inspiration to dream.

A moment here feels like a holiday – and this is what securing a lifestyle property is all about. Think of a walk down the Esplanade past the lookout to one of SA’s best beaches, Sellicks! Or take the jeep, drive on and set up for a day of total relaxation by the sea. In this crazy world, how fortunate we are! And it could be on your very own doorstep.

listings.headline: High Quality Home, Pool and Views!
description: Come and live a foothills lifestyle and enjoy metro convenience. Think of the benefits of living just 10-minutes to our amazing coastline and an easy 25-minutes to Adelaide City. The north-south corridor is happening, Flinders University, Hospital and train station are close, and discover Shepherds Hill Recreation Reserve’s beautiful walking trails.

This superb home was built in 1986 – solid brick downstairs with concrete foundation to both levels, a very rare build quality today. An amazing inground pool setting and outdoor living area takes advantage of an elevated backyard aspect with views to the lights & sea, and the land measures perfect 962sqm.

A concrete drive provides easy entry to a remote double garage under-main roof with a handy workshop and sheltered access to the front door. The home is tucked down from Shepherds Hill Road with a large garden setting out the front and you can fit two more cars in the driveway. Just a thought: Imagine automatic gated entry and perhaps an insulated walling system across the front boundary – completely private and living with this sensational backyard aspect.

It’s a quality build with attractive brickwork and timber windows that give this home its appealing character. The floor plan zones spacious living areas and a home-office downstairs with the three bedrooms feeling private upstairs, and you’ll love the way a huge family room lives with a sensational backyard aspect!

From the front veranda, a formal entry and beautiful staircase make for a welcoming entry. The home-office is in an ideal position adjacent the entry – it could make for an occasional guest room or perhaps a 4th bedroom if needed.

The sunken lounge and separate dining room combine beautifully together. The lounge features a masonry open fireplace which could easily convert to a combustion heater, while the formal dining room looks out to a garden atrium – fill it with greenery and a trickling water feature, light it up at night and what an inviting space this will be.

listings.headline: UNDER APPLICATION
description: Ideally located in cosmopolitan North Adelaide at the end of leafy Stanley Street within walking distance of all the cafes, restaurants and boutiques.
Next to the renowned pub, The Kentish, and Adelaide Oval, the beautiful Parklands, CBD and excellent public transport all close by.
Entry to open plan living/dining with easy care flooring. New galley gas kitchen with rear door to a paved courtyard and carport. Walk through laundry to full bathroom with shower over the bath.

Natural light fills the spacious master suite upstairs open plan to a second lounge/office area with walk-in robe, new RC/AC and new carpet. The balcony fronting Stanley Street sits among the tree-tops, a great spot to relax for a morning cuppa or evening wine.

If you wish to view this property - please email through your enquiry BY EITHER CLICKING ON THE ‘CONTACT AGENT’ BUTTON UNDER THE AGENT INFORMATION OR VIA ‘CONTACT THE AGENT TO ARRANGE AN INSPECTION’ BUTTON – this will enable you to Register Your Interest, Apply Online and receive a response in a timely manner.
We will then also be able to update you on any upcoming inspection/viewing times or inform you of any changes and updates on the property.

listings.headline: A Perfect Home & Investment!
description: At 96sqm and with room to move outside, this delightful place to live is more of a Homette than a unit.

The owners have loved life in 3/14 Ellis Avenue. They have especially appreciated the feeling of being safe & secure while living in a peaceful, house-proud community – all homes in the group are lived in by their owners. The location too is so very convenient to main roads that lead to the beach and city, while the local O’Halloran Hill shopping complex is close-by.

The attractive brickwork and bay window verandah that extends along the front is very appealing, and a nice spot to relax in a day chair or with company and enjoy a pretty garden setting – a wall of greenery creates privacy, and it’s a nice surprise to see thriving veggies, herbs and citrus, what a treat!
Inside feels welcoming and spacious and there is a practical flow to the layout – inside & out, the living is easy. There are 9ft ceilings and construction is solid brick – it was built in 1986.

The lounge-living room is ideally a separate space but also feels connected to the kitchen and dining area when entertaining – it welcomes the north winter sunshine, while the exposed brick fireplace with wall niches at either side is ready for a combustion heater or gas fire.

The original kitchen presents well. You’ll love the way it looks out to the backyard entertaining and greenery! If you dream a new one there is no hurry – and wouldn’t it be fun to design your own down the track. You will be cooking with gas, there is a raised oven, good bench-space where you can seat a few stools and plenty of room for a large fridge!

listings.headline: Imagine Living Here
description: A character Bungalow – Circa 1925; on a fabulous 2292sqm of land (0.57acre).
This beautiful property has been home to one family for a very long time and lives in a truly peaceful and convenient position.

From the front porch and superb outdoor living area, the slight elevation brings in north facing sky-views and a surprise outlook across to the Blackwood Forest where a walk through the trails will bring a peace to your everyday – what an environment to come home to.

The Fine Homes of the Blackwood District each have their own personality and place in time where they are very much a part our local history; they are tightly held and are a rare buying opportunity! Picture 54 Turners Avenue back in the day, living amongst rolling hills of farmland and orchards where the Sturt River meets an idyllic water reserve that is Frank Smith Park; and to think that this is metro-Adelaide – a lifestyle where that ‘Country Feeling meets City Convenience’. Blackwood Village and the train to town are just 5 minutes up the road.

This property is unique in the way an old bitumen tennis court has street frontage which invites great potential in land use, and huge work-sheds at the back of the home – a dream set-up for the car enthusiast, hobbyist or work-from-home trade.

The home and accommodation are intriguing and will especially appeal to the buyer searching for an environment that balances; hassle free living with space and where that classic character seamlessly infuses with modern living inside & out – it’s the best of both worlds. It’s a place where you can simply move in and get on with living and yet, still have some fun with your own ideas.

listings.headline: Everything You Could Wish for ...
description: A young home like this does not come along too often – modern & contemporary and with all the accommodation one could want! It was built in 2010 by Rossdale Homes and lives on a superb 1463sqm of land.

From the alfresco entertaining area, a perfect elevation creates an outlook over the pool and tennis court to an environment of peaceful sunsets and treetops. This amazing north facing backyard setting will be hard to beat and being able to walk to Blackwood Village is a winner!

The day-night synthetic turf Tennis Court is fit for the professional, the landscape is very low maintenance, and with a fully tiled solar-heated inground pool – it all comes together to create resort style living at home. For the growing family, the home and land are a dream, and for couples who love minimalist space and entertaining – 50 Gulfview in Blackwood Central is a wonderful buying opportunity.

• From the street and behind a rendered wall, gated entry ensures the driveway and front yard aspect is secure & private. There is room to park two cars on the flat in front of the oversize double garage which has a work-shop area and a handy roller door for access down the side of the home to the backyard. There is an extra parking bay that may accommodate a boat or caravan.

• A north facing window at the end of a gallery style entry hall frames a glimpse of the pool and lures you inside. It feels fresh, calm and uncluttered with clean white walls, large floor tiles and high ceilings.

• The main bedroom is ideally downstairs and private from the living rooms. It’s a beautiful big room with plantation shutters, a huge walk-in robe/dressing room, and a light-filled ensuite with a large walk-in shower & concealed toilet.

listings.headline: All the Accommodation you could Ask For!
description: Welcome to 5 Stella Street. A proud double story home with an impressive 312sqm of internal living, perfect for the growing family, entertainer or with the potential for 7 bedrooms – the investor too!

Built in 1999 on a flat 588sqm allotment, the home enjoys a near perfect north-south orientation and an end of cul-de-sac position. The location is a beauty! So close to Flinders University & Hospital, Marion Shopping Precinct and being on the Secombe Heights side of Darlington - so connected to our gorgeous coastline.

From the road - the dwelling height, frontage and moldings make for quite an impressive facade. Internally the home presents well, providing the ability to move in & get on with living! However, there is still so much potential here… With such an expansive floorplan #5 has that forever home feeling and with a few adaptations, the potential to be something truly special.

Entering the home, you are welcomed in by the front lounge and a glimpse of green lawns in the distance. The lounge is an inviting room, with 9ft ceilings, fresh white walls & generous 6.3m x 5m dimensions. Being low set from the curb, slightly hidden behind the front gardens/retaining, the space feels private & peaceful. A perfect place to unwind after a long day.

Past the downstairs wet areas – you enter the kitchen, a functional space which presents well. Providing a 5-burner gas cooktop, double oven & dishwasher. The kitchen, meals and living are open plan and work nicely together. The formal dining room is just off the kitchen, and a private lounge space can be found opposite the living. These rooms are quite versatile and could easily be additional accommodation. For now, they form part of four independent living spaces, wow!

With eyes for the future, could you create an expansive open planned living zone? Connecting the formal dining & second lounge with the kitchen & living… While we are daring to dream - with two upstairs bathrooms already in place, does the downstairs bathroom lend itself to a butler’s pantry? There are so many opportunities with this home.

listings.headline: What a place to call Home!
description: Welcome to 14 Boronia Avenue – a much loved & well renovated, single-level 70’s conventional, which lives beautifully within its environment & enjoys a treetop aspect across the Valley!

Sitting on the high side of Boronia Avenue, with a generous set back from the road, established garden setting and eastern orientation – the home lives in privacy and space. The allotment measures 1220sqm & the dwelling position makes for 360-degree enjoyment of the land.

Built in 1973, on a single level floorplan, the home is brick veneer and was recently rendered (not just curb side – all external walls)! Quality improvements are seen inside and out, and you can feel the care & house-proud nature of our owners.

The home features ducted reverse-cycle air conditioning, feeding all rooms. A single garage + double carport under main roof (could this become a triple bay garage?), horseshoe return driveway, dual outdoor entertaining spaces, an above ground pool and flat lawned areas – what an opportunity this is!

A valley facing timber deck with raked pergola acts as an extension of your internal living & doubles as a private front landing. Through the entrance way, an L-shaped living/dining flows nicely and connects to the kitchen & fourth bedroom. It’s quite inviting with lovely levels of natural light, attractive timber-look laminate flooring & treetops in the background. The space adheres to all the creature comforts – with a modern combustion fireplace, ceiling fan, roller blinds, and ducted reverse cycle entry points.

The kitchen is a winner! Re-modeled in 2020, it is a galley style, nicely separated from the living spaces - with an emphasis on sleek design appeal. Black & white cabinetry works well with Granite-look counter tops, and a charcoal backsplash. Appliances are quality, with an electric Omega cooktop and Westinghouse oven. Almost as impressive – a wall of robes spans from the meals into the kitchen space. In combination with the nearby laundry & linen press, you’re spoilt for storage!

listings.headline: Modern and Contemporary Living
description: With Superb Views this beautifully presented home will appeal to families and couples searching for spacious, hassle-free independent living. 100 Highfield Drive is a single level floorplan with no steps inside, elevated on its 754sqm allotment to take every advantage of distant views across Blackwood Park Estate from the entertaining deck. It was built in 2008 and feels like new!
It’s a home in perfect balance and dimension – from the garage to every room inside there a certain energy and practicality that will make everyday living an absolute pleasure.

There are 4 great size bedrooms. The main is private toward the back of the home – it has a large walk-in robe and a fabulous ensuite bathroom! Sliding doors that open to the alfresco deck and those amazing views is a special feature.

Bedroom’s two and three on opposite sides of the hallway are a decent size and both have built-in storage and sliding door access to private decks under main roof! The fourth bedroom at the front of the home feels like a second main room being complemented by a large lounge retreat, and with the huge main bathroom adjacent; for the young adult at home or extended family, it could be perfect.
With two structural wall niches, the main bathroom has more space than most. The enclosed shower alcove is big, and a raised deep soak spa bath will be a luxurious treat.

The lounge retreat is a versatile room – with great wall space for furniture and art it could be the ideal home theatre. 9ft ceilings are consistent throughout and the whole home enjoys complete comfort with zoned ducted reverse cycle air-conditioning.

listings.headline: Imagine Living Here ...
description: Located on the Blackwood side of Coromandel Valley, the land and position are an absolute dream. Come and live with 4663sqm (1.15acres) of your own space, disconnect with sublime views to the Valley Hills and immerse yourself in peaceful surrounds – it is truly quite captivating.

34 Boronia Avenue presents an incredible buying opportunity. The chance to secure real estate like this where; house and land, combined with unique features and valuable extras are very rare and so hard to find. If you have been happy at home and waiting for that once special place, then this could be it … Your Forever Home.
Especially for the growing family, think of weekends at home with –
• The very best in outdoor living and an amazing garden landscape.

The no through road position is ideal and where just a few metres from the front gate, you can take a stroll down to the Sturt River over the bridge to the linear reserve and walk to the Duck Inn and local shops. The popular Coromandel Valley Primary School too.

Automatic gates provide secure entry to the property, and a long, straight concrete drive brings you up to the home which is secluded from street view. At the top of the drive an expansive paved area provides for guest parking and easy turn-around from the triple garage under-main roof!

listings.headline: What a Package!
description: Position Perfect Family Home, Concrete In-Ground Pool and a Sports Court.
This spacious and versatile home lives on the low side of the street with an elevated backyard aspect to greenery and surprise sea views – the land measures 1164sqm!

Amazing isn’t it to think that you can be at Brighton & Seacliff beach in 10 minutes, walk to Flinders University and train station, and feel connected to Sensational Adelaide. The north-south corridor is happening; just imagine living here when it is all complete and think of coming home at the end of your day to birdlife, koalas and a peaceful metro foothills environment. It’s the best!

The home was built in 1971 and provides for spacious living over two levels. Altogether there are 4 bedrooms – 2 bathrooms and 2 large living areas, and if separate accommodation is especially needed; downstairs is self-contained with its own kitchenette, laundry facility and bathroom.
• A concrete drive provides access to a freestanding double carport. Being set well back from the street; there may be potential to landscape and create a new triple bay carport/workshop.
• From the carport, steps down to a garden courtyard provides for a private entry and will be the ideal spot for your herb garden and the morning brew. Give it your own touch and love this space.

description: Interested to learn more - please contact Stephen Ring or Luke Bull.

listings.headline: A Beautiful Piece of Land!
description: The dream to build is alive at #132. It goes without saying, that land like this is becoming very hard to find, especially a glorious 733sqm allotment with views!

The low side of the road is best. It invites the wonderful opportunity to take every advantage of this very special aspect – imagine living with uninterrupted views across the cherished environment of the Sturt River and walking trails, to the Coromandel Valley hills and big-sky views!

The perfect dimension, consistent and gentle slope is ideal. Walk to the middle of the land and picture yourself a few metres in the air. Think of a raised deck, a backyard setting of landscaped gardens and a pool perhaps, and looking out to those views that will only change with the seasons. Amazing.
It’s all about the Location and Position – and at Lot 98, 132 Blackwood Park Boulevard, there is no compromise. What a place to Live.
Come and Live the fortunate lifestyle that Blackwood Park Estate Craigburn Farm provides.

listings.headline: Come Home to the Valley …
description: What a delightful spot this is. Enjoy living with a peaceful backyard setting and a sunny north facing aspect from the huge outdoor living area … and love being a walk around the corner to the fabulous Sturt River Linear Reserve and the hike & bike trails of the Sturt Gorge Recreation Park.

This attractive solid brick home was built in 1984. The accommodation has no steps inside and will appeal to singles, couples, and young families. Being tucked down off the street and with a slight elevation in the backyard – living in this home feels safe & secure, peaceful & private!

The land is larger than most and provides great space in the backyard. There is privacy between neighbouring properties with established greenery and excellent potential to really have some fun and complement with your own landscape and garden ideas.

Inside the floorplan is not too large or too small and works beautifully with the separation of bedrooms and a central living & dining space that is extended by superb outdoor living – you’ll love it out here!
• The main bedroom feels very private and looks out to the backyard setting.

• Bedrooms 2 and 3 have split-system air-conditioning for complete comfort – they share a good size TV/games room; the owners used a bookshelf to partition but with a simple stud-wall this space could easily become a home-office too.

listings.headline: A Home for All!
description: Welcome to 20 Glenwood Drive. An appealing split-level, four-bedroom home, not too big nor too small, perfect for couples, singles, investors or the growing family! Built to entertain & picnic in your own backyard, this home enjoys a near perfect north-south orientation coupled with an elevated aspect across the foothills & metro plains towards our beautiful coastline.

Measuring 900sqm, the land has been nicely terraced and traverses from Glenwood Drive down to the quiet cul-de-sac of Deepdene Avenue. From Deepdene - a private driveway leads to a double garage/work shed, perfect for the hobbyist. From Glenwood - a flat paved driveway accommodates off-street parking for four cars easily & provides the potential for a freestanding carport in time.

Circa 1970, the floor plan is a winner! The split-level smartly separates the bedroom & living wings. An L-shaped living/dining space invites you in and connects through to the kitchen, meals and outdoor entertainment areas. There’s a real warmth & energy in this home, with lovely levels of natural light, glimpses of the sea and greenery peering through large picture windows. Between the living, dining, meals, verandah & outdoor entertaining, there are so many spaces for the family to enjoy & interact – without feeling on top of each other!

The kitchen presents well and provides plentiful storage with dual built-in pantries, as well as additional built-in cabinetry in the meals area. Appliances are quality, both the dishwasher and oven are Westinghouse, but most importantly – we are cooking with gas!

From the kitchen, you are met with the verandah and patio, in combination they create quite an expansive entertaining terrace – 86sqm! - which may lead to your nomination of Christmas host later this year… Theres also a unique, teppanyaki style BBQ and with a quick renovation it would become quite the show piece. A terrace further, you find sweeping lawns. Perfect for the kids to play or for the backyard picnic.

Underneath the suspended concrete verandah lies a surprising under-home store. Measuring 6.9m x 2.6m, there is plenty of space down here for your garden care, camping gear, Christmas tree or future pool equipment…

listings.headline: Invest in Your Future …
description: Here is your chance to buy into Bellevue Heights, and what spot this is! Come and live in a secluded setting where you will feel far from it all and yet be so connected – Brighton & Seacliff Beach is 12 minutes, and metro Adelaide is all just there!

The land is a beautiful residential allotment that measures 1350sqm (0.33 acre). It has a winter creek passing through and the home is surrounded by established trees and greenery. The solid brick home was built in 1969; with a brand-new kitchen it presents well but also comes with abundant potential to improve with your own ideas and really make it your own. And it has a concrete pool! And it's huge!!

Especially for the young couple beginning their journey or for a single person searching for not too large and that little bit more – at this price-level, 64 Yurilla Drive presents a great buying opportunity and a sound investment in your future.
The home is sited toward the back of the allotment and angled in way that takes every advantage of a peaceful front yard aspect.
• 3 bedrooms look out to privacy – the main has built-in robes.
• The original bathroom and separate toilet present an opportunity to renovate in time.

listings.headline: The Perfect Family Home
description: Beautifully presented and well maintained, this great home is fit for the growing family and what a place to be! Live in a no-through street and love the peaceful and elevated north facing backyard – the land measures 1250sqm, there is a superb in-ground pool and two outdoor living areas.

The home was built in 1981 and was later extended with two fabulous bedrooms that may invite different uses – they are huge! Altogether there is 200sqm of living that offers a practical and flowing floor plan that is easy to live in. Since 1995, the owners have loved and cared for their home, and it really does show. 8 Pengana Drive is all set for you to move in and get on with living!

• With a gorgeous landscape of front yard gardens that create a feeling of privacy from street view, a wide concrete driveway provides simple entry into a double garage under-main-roof - there is handy roller door access to the pergola, storage shelves and a workbench. And a real bonus is the gravelled second driveway which could be a home for the boat or caravan.
• The formal entry hall also serves to separate the main bedroom from the living areas – it feels very private. There is an ensuite, a walk-in and an extra built-in robe.

• Double doors open to a lounge-living room that looks out to the front yard gardens and features an open fire with a classic copper canopy. With exposed brick walls and timber laminate flooring, it’s a relaxing space.
• Formal dining is a complement to both the kitchen and lounge room – use it every day or when it comes time to entertain it will easily accommodate a large table setting.

listings.headline: A Modern and Hassle-Free Lifestyle…
description: Welcome to 47 Noble Circuit. A beautifully presented, custom-built Hickinbotham home, with an emphasis on design appeal and a practical single-level floor plan. Finished in 2020, this stylish, hassle-free home sits on 495sqm of highly usable land - within the all new Onkaparinga Heights Estate!

Looking on from the street, what an attractive home this is... Standing proud, with a slightly elevated aspect & wider street frontage than most. A stepped timber deck leads you up to the front landing.

Beautiful double doors open into an inviting & spacious entranceway. An ash grey brick profile looks great in contrast with a rendered feature wall with charcoal light fittings and premium edge guttering. Clerestory windows in the main bedroom were also a nice choice.

Entering the home – a beautiful pendant light immediately catches your eye. Large format laminate floor coverings are equally as eye catching and work well against the living room feature wall & electric fireplace crackling in the distance. Built in robes are a practical inclusion and in conjunction with the walk-in store within the double garage, walk-in butler’s pantry behind the kitchen and laundry – there is plenty of storage space!

2.7m ceilings are constant throughout the home, coupled with a v-lux skylight in the kitchen and large window profiles – it’s hard to feel closed in. The main kitchen/living space is open planned and lives well, integrating nicely with the outdoor entertaining area.

Being the pride and joy of our sellers, the expansive 11 metre gabled pergola ensures you will be the host for Christmas next year! Stylish cladding and quality timbers are real features, while creating additional privacy for the living spaces and backyard.

listings.headline: With all the accommodation one could want – it’s actually 2 homes in 1!
description: The accommodation is unique in that it is all on one level with no steps while the floorplan is zoned in such a practical way that makes living in this home so versatile and easy. You don’t feel lost in a big home and with three-metre ceilings throughout and that amazing outlook, you certainly don’t feel closed-in either. The floorplan will be especially appealing for the growing and extended family – altogether it has 8 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms! It was built by Desyn Homes and completed in 2020.

The long avenue driveway that provides access to the backyard setting and a huge workshop facility at the back of the allotment – for the tradesperson, car enthusiast, boat or caravan or that serious hobby, it is the dream set-up!
For practical everyday use, a wide concrete driveway provides easy entry to a double garage under-main roof, and where there is extra room in front of the garage for guest parking.
• The home is private from the street view ideally on the low side of the street taking every advantage of an elevated backyard aspect – it is glorious!

• From the portico, a wide formal entry is very welcoming. Exquisite, tiled flooring and those 3 metre ceilings are impressive, you can see all the way through to the feature stone wall in the main living area and there is secure internal access from the garage.

• The huge main bedroom enjoys a peaceful outlook and feels very private from the rest of the home. It has a large walk-in robe and ensuite with floor-to-ceiling tiles and a walk-in shower. Complementing the main bedroom is a large home-office – or dare we say, bedroom 9!

listings.headline: A Dream Backyard – 1710sqm! And a Highly Renovated Home.
description: Evoking almost that new home feeling, 14 Shepherd Court is simply – move in and get on with living!
Built in 1978 #14 is a stylish, renovated, split level home with a subtle Spanish influence. Situated on a glorious 1710sqm (0.422 acre) allotment!

Positioned within one of Coromandel Valleys’ most desirable enclaves – this is one you don’t want to miss. Looking on from the street, the all-white render isn’t just a façade, it extends all sides of the home. The cement tiled roof has been completely renovated, along with the timber fascia's, gutters & railings surrounding the carport – which is all under main roof!

Creating open plan, modern living was the goal for our owners. The old galley style kitchen was re-designed to connect the living, dining, kitchen & outdoor entertainment areas. Now it serves as a spacious, renovated living zone which lives beautifully & interacts well with a large, paved patio & verandah.

The continental kitchen acts as a central hub. A grey subway tile splash back works well against white cabinetry with black accents. Fitted with quality appliances, the induction cooktop & oven is Bosch, the dishwasher is Fisher & Paykel, and the LG Double Fridge could be yours too!

New laminate floor coverings extend through the kitchen & living space to a central combustion fire and large split-system air conditioner. Every window has been replaced, including the back sliding door. New LED light fittings look great, even power points & light switches have been renewed.

listings.headline: Dual Street Frontage with a Beautiful Northern Aspect!
description: Welcome to 20 Glengyle Avenue - A wonderful 1290sqm allotment with near perfect dimensions, on the Belair side of Blackwood!

Within walking distance from the Blackwood Village, this special piece of land takes advantage of the perfect orientation - a true north-south alignment. Building to the land, an elevated aspect allows you to create something completely bespoke…
Picture a proud split-level home, with floor to ceiling window profiles - encapsulating the rolling foothills and treetops in the distance.

A lush, natural streetscape surrounds Glengyle Avenue – it’s a quiet & secluded residential street with no through traffic. Walking over the land with the bird life in the distance, it’s hard to believe you are still in metro Adelaide. Brighton beach and Stirling are equidistant at 15 minutes to each, while the city is only 25 minutes away!
Secondary street frontage from Hannaford Road is invaluable, especially for the building process, while providing unique opportunities and additional usability for the house & land.
Think safe off-street storage of the boat or caravan, additional garaging or workshop for the hobbyist or private studio access for your lucky teenager….

listings.headline: Be at Home in the Valley
description: What a dream position this is and with an amazing backyard environment that fronts the Sturt River Linear Reserve – a peaceful lifestyle doesn’t get much better than this.

Shepherd Court is an enclave of homes nestled behind the river and the natural environment of McTaggart Reserve. A no-through street that services just its resident’s and with no overhead power lines – a secluded position that takes every advantage of the linear reserve walking trails that will be a part of your every day!
The home was built in 1978 by the current owner. Tucked down from the street with a private frontage and an elevated backyard aspect – the land is a very special 1120sqm.

It’s a quality home with a certain understated character, split-level in design and with abundant potential! It lives well now but also invites the opportunity to improve and make changes with your own ideas to really make it your own – and when you love where you live, in time, there appears to be great scope to build on out the back – it’s certainly nice to have the option.

• A concrete drive provides access to a large double-garage under-main roof. It has remote entry and a great little workshop space with a window outlook! When building the home, the owners chose to have a separate laundry which is also at the back of the garage – it’s different, but it works!
• A wide formal entrance that turns into the hallway also serves to separate the bedrooms from the living areas making them feel private.

listings.headline: A Quality Home – Living with Views!
description: 9 College Avenue has been home to one family and is a fine example of superior build quality! With an Architectural influence, the home is all solid brick and built on concrete foundation on both levels.

For the owners in 1975, their home was designed and built just for them and to take every advantage of views to the lights, sea & amazing sunsets! The land measures 998sqm, it’s the perfect size and with a fabulous backyard setting – all useable, very private and with beautifully established gardens.

Please study the floorplan – the split-level design separates bedrooms and living areas to create that feeling of independent living across two levels. Especially for the buyer needing versatile living-space instead of bedrooms, it could be perfect.

There are two huge bedrooms, two bathrooms and two living areas – the downstairs games room could certainly be converted into a third bedroom if needed, and it has the potential to be self-contained too!
You just know when you are living in a well-built home – you can sense and feel it. Inside is peacefully quiet and with a certain ambience and character all-of-its-own. And you are living with Views!

• The home is sited beautifully with a wide and open frontage, and where you can enjoy both front and backyards. A concrete driveway provides easy entry into a double garage under-main roof. You can easily park two more cars on the flat in front of the garage doors – one is a manual lift and the other is remote. The garage has 3.3m ceilings with potential to create mezzanine storage – there is also a hatch to a sneaky storage area and stairway access up to the back porch.

listings.headline: A Perfect First Home & Investment ...
description: And for buyers searching for spacious and hassle-free living!

A Torrens Title Townhouse with a fabulous backyard environment that takes in a north-eastern aspect – beautiful in winter and shaded in summer. An intimate group of only three, built in 2012, and positioned in a convenient and peaceful spot within Oaklands Park.

The location is an absolute beauty. Equidistant in every direction – the beach, Flinders University & Hospital, Westfield Marion is just there, easy access out to main roads, the bus and the brilliant Oaklands Park train terminal to Brighton, Seacliff and City means you can leave the car in the garage!

The three modern contemporary homes were built by the current owner. Construction is rendered Hebel veneer and a Colorbond roof, and the land measures 261sqm – when allotments are getting smaller, room to move in the backyard is a unique feature and a luxury to own!
• The floorplan is spacious with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms upstairs and open plan living!
• The remote access garage has secure internal entry inside to the entrance hall; the stairwell also provides excellent storage underneath.

listings.headline: A Fabulous Backyard Setting!
description: And the position within Blackwood Park is superb. Central, convenient and a few steps to Duck Pond Reserve and nature trails.

A backyard setting like this can be hard to find in Craigburn Farm. The all useable land is free of easements and takes advantage of a slightly elevated position with a surprise northeast outlook from the backyard. The allotment measures 908sqm and provides access through to a triple bay garage and work shed – for the camper trailer, boat, caravan, or the classic car – it’s a great set up! There are open lawn and garden areas, a flat paved terrace and an above ground pool that has been landscaped into the ground!

• The secure and remote entry double carport enables drive through access over a flat lawn to the triple bay garage and work shed at the back of the land. In front and behind the work shed, formed concrete extends the useability and function of this brilliant feature.

• In the first bay, a roller door at the back provides access to a handy nook for great rainwater storage potential or even more space to perhaps swing around a camper trailer. The third bay was partitioned to create an excellent workshop facility!

The home was built in 2001 and offers a flowing floorplan where the overall size will be especially appealing to the growing family and couples searching for spacious and hassle-free living! There are no steps inside and it’s very easy to move around outside too. 3 Dawbiney Avenue presents maintenance free and in original good condition – simply move and get on with living, and if you love the idea of making a home your own, there is abundant potential too.
• Decorative pillars and bulkhead ceilings frame the huge open plan lounge and dining area.

listings.headline: Secluded & Spacious
description: Come and escape to a lush 1489sqm setting where you’ll feel far from it all. At the end of a long driveway hidden from street view, this well-presented family home with no steps has a fabulous floorplan that will appeal to couples too!

It’s hard to believe that the beach is less than 15 minutes and driving to Sensational Adelaide City is easy. The north-south corridor is happening, and the Flinders University and train station is walking distance. What a place to live.
A winter creek passes through the land, and the home is sited toward the back of the allotment, slightly elevated to take advantage of a delightful front yard aspect.

Separate to the home and a short walk up the drive, there is a double carport with a garage behind. It’s a modern work shed with good height and potential for mezzanine storage; it has its own power source and for the person who likes to tinker about on weekends, you can really lose yourself here.

The home was built in 1990 by highly regarded builder David Knight. It is a relatively young home for the area – brick veneer on a concrete slab foundation, with a cement tiled roof and 9ft ceilings throughout.

Altogether, there are 4 bedrooms plus 2 bathrooms and 3 living areas. All rooms have good dimensions and the entire home presents in excellent condition! With fresh paintwork and quality new carpet throughout it is move in and get on with living. When the time is right, there is simple potential to have some fun and upgrade kitchen and bathrooms with your own ideas.

listings.headline: A PRIVATE SALE
description: Location and Position is everything! Here is your chance to buy into Belair and secure a sound investment in your future.

The land measures 840sqm and has surprise views through to the lights from the front yard, and distant views to the hills from the backyard. The slight elevation welcomes a north facing aspect and the home is sited to provide for a fabulous backyard setting!
The original weatherboard cottage was built circa 1955 and received an extension in 2007 to create the spacious and comfortable home it is today.
A gravel driveway provides easy access to a garage that has been divided to create a separate workshop-studio behind, and living outdoors will be a treat with a great size decked pergola.

The versatile floorplan offers that little bit more and zones the bedrooms away from the main living area. The whole home is filled with natural light and invites the new owner to create their own unique feeling of home. With fresh paint and new carpets, it presents ready for you to move in and get on with living!
• The main living and dining room enjoy a peaceful outlook to front yard gardens. You can see the night lights.

listings.headline: A Sanctuary in the Valley
description: What a place to live! The seller came from the land and needed a home where that country feeling combined city convenience – and 15 Shepherd Court was perfect! They have loved their home and especially the way it lives so connected with the environment, private and so peaceful!
Shepherd Court is an enclave of homes nestled behind the Sturt River. A unique position that takes every advantage of the Linear Reserve walking trails that will be a part of your every day.

Imagine, leaving the front door and taking a stroll, walk or run, north or south in this unique environment. And from the backyard of this elevated half-acre (1960sqm) setting, the outlook north to McTaggart Reserve is very special – a natural tree-studded reserve with a stand of majestic Eucalypts that take you somewhere else. At the end of your day or weekends at home, immersed in that country feeling … what a tonic!
The Ranch style home was built in 1977 and it’s quality! Built upon a huge concrete slab and sited toward the back of the allotment to create an outlook to the trees and hills. It is simply glorious.

The accommodation is spacious and homely, and well-designed where bedrooms at both ends of the home are zoned away from the central living areas. Especially for the growing family it is ideal, and being so practical, the floorplan may appeal to couples too!

Love it as it is, but this home also has abundant potential. The building is brick-veneer and with the huge garage being under-main-roof and with so much room outside to create – could the garage be turned in to the ultimate games room retreat or perhaps a studio-apartment for the extended family.

listings.headline: Mid-Century Home with Views!
description: Circa 1957 – Split level in design and built to take every advantage of a true northeast aspect with views to the city lights and to Mount Lofty. The angled roofline with extended eaves and high window profiles gives this home its classic mid-century edge and timeless appeal.

The position within Eden Hills is spectacular and all usable 900sqm of land is simply perfect! It is rare to be able to enjoy the benefits of living in both the front and backyard settings, and here at 76 Hillcrest Drive – they are an absolute treat!

From the street beautifully landscaped gardens rise to a terraced lawn area and surrounding patios that take in an amazing vista. What a tonic this is with night lights and the natural environment of our flourishing Shepherds Hill Recreation Reserve, and where access to the walking trails is just around the corner. While in the front corner facing the city lights there is a private fire pit area that, on special occasions, will give that holiday feeling right at home.

From the hardwood deck and pergola across the back of the home where dry stone stacked walls frame thriving greenery – a real labour of love over time for the owner, one stone at a time – a fabulous open backyard setting with big sky views is so perfectly presented. There is a raised platform deck & a terraced nook, a handy garden shed & wood store, a wandering pathway behind open lawn space and a gravelled terrace where you can lay out a few chairs and take in your environment. It is bliss!

The original home was built specifically for its owner, circa 1957. Modest in size with one bedroom, but with two living areas, a central kitchen and a lock-up garage under main roof. Today, it offers three great size bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a large kitchen laundry that looks over the split-level living room. It is practical, versatile and simply lives well!
• A concrete driveway together with a second gravel area in front of the stone wall provides plenty of room for off-street parking.

listings.headline: A PRIVATE SALE
description: Sold by Private Sale with RING Real Estate buyer contact system.
910sqm allotment, a peaceful position, 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.

Interested to learn more - please contact Stephen Ring or Luke Bull.
[View property features](https://ring-sa.com.au/buy-residential-real-estate/house-30-ashmore-road-bellevue-heights-sa-1127412208#featuresModal)

listings.headline: A PRIVATE SALE
description: Sold by Private Sale with RING Real Estate buyer contact system.
Interested to learn more - please contact Stephen Ring or Luke Bull.

listings.headline: A Delightful Place to call Home
description: Opposite our beautiful Belair National Park, what a place to live… and with a surprise backyard setting!

126 Upper Sturt Road is an attractive 70’s built red brick character home that presents beautifully and offers a little more than most – inside & out! The home is tucked down off the road and takes every advantage of an elevated backyard aspect with big-sky views and an outlook to treetops.

The home is sited perfectly on its 909sqm allotment, where front gardens create privacy from Upper Sturt Road and driveway access is easy to a large carport under-main roof – you can fit two cars lengthways. We live in the backyard, and this one is a beauty! There is open lawn space for kids’ playtime, and the family hound will love you for it too. There is a large garden shed with a concrete floor, a sheltered nook for the barbeque and a quality concrete in-ground pool. For the young and growing family, it doesn’t get much better.
Inside the home is ready for you to move and get on with living – no big renovation project is needed here. And for a home of its size, it offers a modern and spacious floorplan.

• The formal entry and hallway also serve to keep the bedrooms private from the kitchen and living areas. Three bedrooms are all a nice size and share an upgraded main bathroom and ideally a separate toilet. The laundry presents well too.
• For complete comfort there is ducted reverse-cycle air-conditioning and a split-system unit to the extension.

listings.headline: With that Mid-Century Appeal …
description: And what a spot this is too. Douglas Street is an incredibly peaceful and convenient place to live where out the back of this 1300sqm allotment you will feel far from it all! The elevated outlook from inside the home, out on the deck and in the flat yard space to a naturally beautiful setting will be a part of your every day. It is what a lifestyle in Eden Hills is all about.

Especially for the young and growing family, the location and position present a truly wonderful buying opportunity. If Blackwood Primary and High Schools are preferred, then with the pedestrian crossing a short walk up the road, children and teenagers can safely get themselves to and from school, and the Rec Centre too!

You can even walk through Wittunga Botanic Gardens to Coromandel train station, walk to Blackwood Village and as the owners do – take advantage of the amazing bike trails of the Sturt Gorge Recreation reserve. Douglas Street is a no-through street, surprisingly peaceful and oh’ so convenient.

The low side of the street is the best because it provides for an elevated aspect in the backyard – it’s where we live most. #5 is tucked down off the street with a brick paved driveway that sweeps across landscaped native gardens to a freestanding double carport. The original driveway accessed a carport under-main roof, which the owners have screened with timber slat gates to create a useful bike storage and utility area – and where there is very real potential to enclose and create another living area if needed.

For the owners, this 1971 built split-level floorplan inspired their passion for the mid-century aesthetic – a timeless quality inherent in contemporary design. And from the outside to the fabulous indoors the owners have achieved their goals by lovingly restoring #5 to be a practical and modern home with an energy all-of-its-own. It is simply move in and get on with living!

• At street level, you can’t help but notice the long linear cement tiled roofline which has been restored and completed with aluminium gutter guard, and admire rock filled gabion retaining walls and native plantings that follow the driveway to create a welcoming habitat across the front.

listings.headline: With a Big Backyard and Surprise Views!
description: Secure your spot in Eden Hills and love being so connected to the beach and metro Adelaide.
Circa 1960 – It’s a home with that mid century appeal; solid brick, split-level in design and with a suspended concrete floor to the main living area above the garage.

Everything has potential, but here it is abundant inside & out! And there is no rush. Move in, get to know your home, and in time have fun and make plans for exciting improvements that will take this place to a whole new level. The owner has certainly provided a valuable head start – the very cool Colorbond roof and gutters in Surf Mist is new, and there is brand new ducted reverse cycle air conditioning throughout!

With a 20m frontage, the home is sited well back from Shepherds Hill Road and lives on a 910sqm allotment free of easements. A flat driveway provides excellent off-street parking and entry to a garage workshop under the home and handy access to the backyard. You can see city lights in the backyard and think of a fence and gates across the front to take full advantage of large front yard setting.
• Inside, the original kitchen presents well and the terrazzo bathroom too.
• There are three bedrooms and a sun room or home office. You can see the sea!

listings.headline: A Wonderful Place to Live
description: What a spot this is! Acacia Road is a no-through street that runs parallel to the Minno Creek Linear reserve where you can enjoy a nature walk down to Apex Park, Joan’s Pantry and the Hawthorndene Oval. And in the other direction, you can walk through to Sherwood Reserve up to the Belair Hotel or take a bike ride through pretty streetscapes to Belair National Park. Blackwood train station is a short walk too!

16 Acacia lives on a flat 1020sqm allotment with no neighbour’s opposite – just an outlook to majestic Eucalypts and a beautifully natural environment. In both front and back yards, the feeling is so private and peaceful. It really is quite special.
This attractive brick-veneer and terra-cotta tile home has loads of character and a spacious warmth inside – the floorplan will appeal to families and couples too!

• Flat driveway entry is easy to a large double carport under-main-roof, and off to the side there is plenty of room for the caravan and more parking too. And conveniently, in just a few steps, sliding doors bring you inside to the kitchen area and home.

• A great feature is the paved access to a garage-workshop – for the tradesperson or hobbyist it is an ideal set-up! There is 3-phase power, an old workbench, storage racks and through windows a pleasant connection to the garden courtyard that will make tinkering about a simple pleasure.

• The kitchen presents well and enjoys a glorious outlook. It’s modern with black granite benchtops, glass splashbacks and quality appliances. Excellent storage includes a corner pantry, and it combines perfectly with a large family dining room – both the kitchen and dining room have exposed timber floors, and the two rooms together feel more like a practical everyday living area.

listings.headline: Lifestyle & Investment
description: What a place to live and invest. On the doorstep of Sensational Adelaide with the fabulous parkland’s environment of Victoria Park across the road. Equidistant to Hutt and Rundle Street precincts, Norwood Village and you feel connected with easy access to main roads in every direction. What a Lifestyle.

Apartment 312 lives in the southern flank with a perfect elevation from two tiled balconies that provide outdoor living, and with a wall of windows that span the length of the apartment. A view to the Adelaide Hills is a surprise and the aspect feels secluded and private.
With a lovely connection to the owner, this has been home to a wonderful Tenant for many years. For the investor or buyer looking to move in down the track – the perfect Tenant is already in place.

Everything about this apartment complex seems easy. The underbuilding drive-through entry is ideal for transport pick-up where you have secure entry in-and-out of the main foyer, and it’s also home to the popular Commissary Café & Restaurant – a real treat just downstairs! From the foyer, tucked away in the corner is a great size exercise room and gym, and access to separate car parking with remote entry for one and simple driveway points that make life easy to navigate!

In a heartbeat, lifts take you to level three where the wide and quiet hallways lead you around the corner to #312. Inside feels like a home, it is safe & secure and very private. You don’t feel closed-in and with those two big balconies, loads of natural light and sky-views there is a sense of place with a disconnect from city-life which is at your doorstep.

The practical layout works beautifully and separates the bedroom, bathroom and laundry away from the open plan studio-style living area. The bedroom has a large walk-in robe big enough for extra storage, while sliding glass doors open to the sights & sounds and breezes from our south-eastern parklands. The all-tiled bathroom is like an ensuite and presents well, and the adjacent laundry too!

description: Located within a very special enclave, is 3 William Rufus the opportunity you have been dreaming of?
With nothing but nature and the environment at your back fence, the irregular shape 1291sqm of rare earth offers a truly glorious setting and a wonderful lifestyle.
This parcel of land feels tucked away at the end of the street and with 45 meters of reserve frontage and measuring 1291sqm (0.32 of an acre), it is double the average block size for Craigburn Farm.

The gentle and consistent slope takes in a sweeping north-east orientation and together with the overall space, it beholds an exciting build opportunity and invites an array of intriguing design options. If you have the dream to create a one-of-a-kind home designed especially for you, then 3 William Rufus is a unique buying opportunity.

At the end of a no-through street, the feeling is peaceful and private. Imagine living with views of the environment, the warm winter sunshine and shade in summer, and with room to move all around the home – an outdoor landscape to match would be a feature in-itself.

The owner has two sets of privately owned architect designed plans which they are happy to share with the new owners to be. Both have City of Mitcham development approvals – could this be ready-set-go!

listings.headline: A Mid-Century Classic!
description: Inspired by renown Adelaide Architect Ian Hannaford and built in 1965 – it’s a classic!

In every room, 180-degree views of the Adelaide plains to the airport and city centre are captivating! The north-west aspect is perfect, and just imagine living every day with big-sky sunsets and a horizon of blue sea from Somerton Park to Henley Beach.

Belair Road is the gateway to the metro-foothills where the Windy Point restaurant and lookout are just up the road. Living here provides that real feeling of disconnect and yet it’s so convenient – the urban lifestyle is all in front of you, and you can see it!

The home is privately nestled into its 1247sqm allotment – ideally on the low side of the road where you can take every advantage of a backyard environment with abundant potential! A concrete driveway turns into a large double carport with turn-around space and off-street parking for visitors.

Contemporary homes of the 60’s with an Architectural influence in design and style, were most often built with a vision and a certain quality that give them their timeless appeal. Here at #318, Architect Ian Hannaford celebrates a complex simplicity with raw materials like concrete, timber and glass – and together with a few quirks and unique features, he created a home that has been cherished by one family and is truly one-of-a-kind.

The superior solid construction and suspended concrete slab floor between the levels makes this home a peaceful place to live in, and every window frames a view! The bedrooms feel private upstairs while the living areas share a practical flow and have a real sense of minimalist and space.

listings.headline: Flat Land, Spacious & Hassle-Free Living
description: 9 Alpha Road is a well-cared for home with a certain character and built to stand the test of time. It presents in original good condition where you can move in and in your own time – plan exciting improvements and take it to a whole new level!

It was built in 1982, has superior concrete slab floor and solid brick construction, and a real sense of space throughout with 9ft ceilings, while every room in the home has great dimensions! The dark terra-cotta tiled roof has a higher profile and extends to the verandah across the front and creates alfresco living out the back. #9 has an understated character, simply lives well and oozes potential!

The all-useable land measures 690sqm and is completely flat. A north facing backyard environment is ideal and the position within Bellevue Heights is so convenient – surroundings streets provide flat walking, Manson Oval reserve is a few hundred metres and the Bellevue Heights Primary School too, there are no worries to catch the bus, and you can even take a short cut walk down a pedestrian lane to the Eden Hills train station. In this spot, you just feel connected!

Behind a steel picket fence and a gated entry, driveway access is easy to an over-sized garage under-main roof with great height ceilings and internal entry to your home. There is room for the workbench and tools in the garage and there is easily room for two cars in the driveway.
• A wide formal entry is always preferred and with a return hallway they also serve to separate the bedrooms and bathroom from the main living areas.
• All three bedrooms are a good size and will easily accommodate new built-in robes. They share a main bathroom and ideally a separate toilet.
