listings.headline: A Perfect Place to Live!
description: St Georges Terrace is a central enclave within Bellevue Heights where you can enjoy easy walking around neighbouring streets, take a short cut through to Manson Oval reserve and also enjoy a scenic walk or bike ride to the back of Flinders University just down the road. It is peacefully convenient and you’ll be at Seacliff & Brighton beach in 15 minutes!

This versatile home offers the buyer a spacious and hassle-free lifestyle with the opportunity to move in and get on with living, and in time, make a few changes and take this home to a whole new level.

The 797sqm of land is all flat with a sweeping frontage and a fabulous backyard setting. The home is made of that solid brick quality with an attractive long brick profile and a high pitch terra cotta tiled roof – together they give this home character! Built in 1970, inside 9ft ceilings create a sense of space and exposed timber floors throughout look great.

The original floor plan provided for three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a large lounge & formal dining, and a spacious walk through kitchen with an everyday dining area that looks out over the secure backyard. This family home grew in the late 80’s with a simple extension that created a link to two huge rooms that really can be whatever you decide.
Today altogether, there are four bedrooms and two bathrooms and three living areas – not including the kitchen. Bedroom five could be created if needed.
• It is always preferred to have a formal entry and in a practical way it also serves to zone the living areas away from the bedrooms.

listings.headline: 80’s Contemporary & a Dream Position!
description: This great home lives with an elevated aspect and views through to the Valley’ Hills. The no-through street is ideal, and think of a short walk around the corner to the fun & fabulous environment of Weymouth Oval Reserve and Community Centre. You can take a trail walk to the Sturt River Linear Park or simply enjoy the benefits of walking around peaceful streetscapes.

The home was built in 1983, and the land measures 770sqm – it’s a beautiful allotment with the house sited perfectly to take advantage of a surprise outlook. A lovely frontage of gardens blend into an open lawn setting that runs nearly the length of the home to one side – for buyers searching for that feeling of environment without the huge land to take care of, then this could be the one!

A wide paved driveway provides easy entry to a big double carport where the angled roofline and brick pillars are in keeping with the contemporary style of the home – and from the carport, there is a sheltered walk-way through to the portico and inside.

The family floorplan is a winner and the contemporary style brings an energy all-of-its-own! With a certain flow to it – the layout is practical and wastes no space, brings family together and provides separation too, while – the split-level design and angled ceilings, exposed brick walls and a window outlook from the living areas make this a home easy to live in.

• The sunken lounge is a great space – it is a true lounge where you can cosy-in around a built-in gas fire and look out through big windows to greenery and sky-views. Use it everyday as a retreat for Mum and Dad, and when it comes time to entertain, it will the perfect spot to relax with friends.

• The kitchen has direct access to superb outdoor living and a window outlook the owners will miss! It’s a big kitchen space complemented by an everyday dining area with room for a large table setting – it performs beautifully with a walk-in pantry, great bench space and a window servery to the family room, and when it comes time for a new one – it will have great design scope and abundant potential!

listings.headline: Mid-Century Studio Unit …
description: This completely renovated one bedroom unit lives in a peaceful group and feels private in a row of four at the back of the allotment. It has its own carport attached and a sneaky view of the sea from the living room and front gardens – the slight elevation and sunny north facing aspect is an absolute delight and quite a surprise!

The feeling inside is safe, secure and homely, and with a simple energy that invokes a real sense of comfort and place. For the buyer looking for not-too-large-or-too-small and with a certain independence in a tightly-held community of home units – this presents a very unique buying-opportunity.
With an estimated rent return; $400.00 to $430.00 per week – it’s one for the investor too!

The location and position within Eden Hills are a winner! The Flinders train station is within walking distance, the University and Hospital too! A walk around the corner and you can access the amazing environment of the Shepherds Hill recreation reserve and its hiking trails, Brighton beach is 12 minutes, Pasadena Shopping in 7 minutes, and a commute to the city is easy.

The 60’s mid-century style is uniquely different and very appealing – inside, textured solid brick walls give it a rustic feel, while the insulated skillion roof profile with angled raked ceilings are character features.

The living room is open plan to the kitchen – it's cosy and very comfortable indeed. Beautiful sheer curtains and vertical blinds are brand-new; they frame a big window that brings inside plenty of natural light and evening breezes, you can see the sea and appreciate sky-views!

listings.headline: A Delightful Home-Unit …
description: Inside is a little larger than most, and being an end unit in a row of four, and divided by a remote lock-up garage – the feeling is private, safe & secure.
The Shepherds Hill Road position is convenient with a short drive to Blackwood Village or in the other direction to Flinders University & Hospital, Brighton beach and Westfield Marion in 10 minutes.
This group of character home-units were built in 1972 – there are two rows of four and each unit is divided by a lock-up garage.
• Inside the overall dimensions are appealing! The main bedroom has a wall of built-in robes, bedroom two is a good size too – and both rooms look out to front yard gardens.
• The bathroom is complete with a shower, bath, toilet and vanity. And like the whole unit, it presents in excellent condition. There is handy linen storage in the hallway nook.
• Behind the garage with internal entry, is the separate laundry – and it’s a great size. There is room for a fridge, washing-machine and dryer – and direct access to the back courtyard.

listings.headline: A Cottage in the Hills
description: Willowie Street is a such a delightful spot – a link road nestled into the very heart of Eden Hills, where at the end of the street, the old Post-Office and Deli used to be. For the young family, it’s a short walk around the corner to the local and popular Primary School, and you can leave the car at home with a scenic and short train ride into Adelaide.
The 1957 Cottage is one of the classic Mitcham Hills timber frame homes. It has a tiled roof and presents in good original condition with the fabulous opportunity to really make it your own!

On the high side of the street, the home is sited toward the back of its 890sqm allotment enjoying an elevated and sunny north facing aspect – think of being out on the front deck with the warm winter sun, big-sky views and an outlook to treetops. It is blissful!

Inside, the accommodation is not too large or too small – high ceilings create a sense of space and every window looks out to greenery. There are three bedrooms and one bathroom, a galley-style kitchen-dining, and a lounge-living that opens out onto the deck.

Picture a fresh coat of paint throughout, polished timber floors, some new light fittings and soft furnishings – complement that cottage charm with a vibrant and modern look and profit in more ways than one! It is the perfect canvas to have fun and create.

A sloping driveway swings around to the front of the home where there is space for 3 cars and plenty of room to turn around too. An old iron work-shed has been turned into a hobby-studio with partition wall, wall linings and built-in desks with storage areas. A great space for the hobbyist!

listings.headline: This simply is … a Wonderful Place to Live!
description: In every way the position is so connected to all that our Blackwood District community has to offer – children can get themselves to our Primary and High School, Concordia St Peters is just up the street, you can walk to the train, central Blackwood shopping and cafes are close, the Football Club is a fabulous place to be a part of and the Rec Centre too, the walking and bike trails of the Sturt Gorge Reserve are just there – it’s all on the doorstep of 35 Clarence Street, a safe and secure family environment.

The home itself is a beauty too. Altogether it has four bedrooms, three bathrooms and independent living zones that will especially appeal to the growing family, or buyers searching for versatile studio space that could have many different uses. With a beautiful Basket Range stone façade – the solid brick and cement tiled home was built in 1966 and received a well-designed extension in the early 90’s!

The land measures a perfect 1088sqm, it’s free of easements and being a corner site it has two street frontages - very handy feature to own! A paved driveway provides simple entry to a wide and good height double carport, and around the corner on Trevor Terrace, there is access to an iron garage-work-shed.

Across the front of the home, windows are double-glazed and timber profiled in other areas. Inside, the home presents well and at 205sqm – the floorplan layout is deceptively spacious! The bedrooms feel private from main living areas, while the extension creates a good problem; there are two main bedrooms! Mum and Dad can choose their room or have their very own domain.

• The original main bedroom has a walk-in-robe and a light filled ensuite. Bedroom two is a single room – perfect for the little ones and with built-in storage could be used as a home-office. Bedroom three is a nice size with built-in robes + an extra IKEA storage robe.
• The main bathroom in its own hallway is private, there is ideally a separate toilet and the laundry with access to the courtyard is here too.

listings.headline: A Fabulous and Fun Backyard Setting …
description: With six bedrooms + a home-office, this home is all set for the growing family and is feature packed with many extras – there is a detached studio-workshop, huge off-street parking and a superb outdoor lifestyle!

This is a place where you can move in and get on with living, and in your own time – complement with your ideas, release its potential even further and really make this great home your own! It’s such a brilliant package – that you may never need to move again.

Excellent off-street parking can be hard to find, and having the luxury, the owners have used the secure carport as part of their outdoor living. There is room for four cars undercover and a huge paved terrace out the front where you can easily fit another three cars. Behind the freestanding double carport, the original secure carport under-main roof will fit two cars lengthways and having access through to the studio style workshop is a wonderful facility to have.

With the double-storey home sited beautifully, the allotment feels so much bigger! The completely flat and all useable land measures 790sqm and provides for a sensational backyard setting! It’s extremely private with fence lines of greenery, wide open lawn areas, and extensive paved areas for outdoor living. There is a good-size garden shed attached to the studio, a chicken coup, a spot for the fire-pit, wood storage and you’ll love the night lights!
With room to move it is very versatile, its everyday practical and will come into its own when entertaining – it simply lives well!

Mum and Dad will appreciate having their own space upstairs – it has that feeling of being in a holiday apartment! The main bedroom has a walk-in-robe plus a second robe facility with huge storage. Having a separate bathroom is ideal, there is a home-office with a built-in desk + library, and a spare bedroom that could be whatever you decide. There is a kitchenette up here and sliding doors open to quite a large tiled alfresco with views north-east over the backyard.

listings.headline: Live with Views ...
description: This well-presented family home feels private from street view and takes every advantage of its elevated aspect with views across the Sturt Gorge Recreation Park to our amazing coastline!

A detached studio complete with its own bathroom and secure off-street parking for three are brilliant features. Solid brick and with a suspended concrete floor, the workshop complete with power and storage also enjoys sea views, while the air-conditioned studio underneath is the ideal home-office or a perfect space for one lucky teenager.
The home was built in 1975 and the land measures 930sqm. The reverse two-storey accommodation will especially appeal to the growing family, and may also have the potential to be two-homes-in-one!

• With access out onto the concrete balcony and views as far as the eye can see, the main living areas combine in a beautiful way. The kitchen presents well and is open to the everyday dining area, while the main living room feels separate when it comes time to lounge around the TV.

• The kitchen with display cabinetry and practical storage is made of real timber, it is in excellent condition and goes hand-in-hand with the natural slate flooring that extends through to the dining. There is room for a double-fridge, a free-standing stainless-steel cooking range with a gas cook-top and electric fan-forced oven, there is a dishwasher – but with views from kitchen sink, who needs one!

• The original garage under-main-roof was smartly converted to create a games-room-retreat. The owners use it as a large country-style dining room, but being so versatile – it has many potential uses for you to decide.

listings.headline: Look at Me!
description: Hillsdale Avenue is an incredibly peaceful place to live – you can walk safely to the Duck-Inn and local bakery, the Sturt Linear Reserve is a treat, and a lap around neighbouring streets past Oak Tree reserve typifies the Coro Valley Lifestyle.
The home was built in 1975 and is sited on the high-side of the street – the land measures 850sqm.
A concrete drive provides access to a remote double carport and a really handy feature is the extra width to the side that allows for a third car or camper-trailer.

The backyard is a real surprise too! From the huge entertaining deck that spans the length of the home, two terraced areas of green lawn rise to the back corner where a flat platform area provides a hillside outlook of sunsets and big-sky views!

The elevated setting receives the warm winter sun to the north, critical retaining and fencing to all boundaries are new, there is a covered cultivating shade-house area and a large garden-work-shed, while a dividing walkway between the neighbours creates separation and privacy!
Isn’t it nice to have space in your very own backyard environment – the kids and family hound will love it, and if you enjoy being out in the garden – it is all set for you to take it another level.

listings.headline: Exclusive Vacant Land Opportunity!
description: This is one of the last remaining sites in Blackwood Park – and what a prime piece of real estate this is.
Imagine living with your own space on a beautiful 1819sqm of land, where you don’t feel closed-in and with 54m of reserve frontage!

Driveway access is right at the end of prestigious Gartrell Boulevard making it feel private from neighbouring properties. The irregular shape, gentle slope and great size will provide many build options – think of a custom design home and landscape bespoken just for you, a one-of-a-kind property that takes every advantage of this very special position amongst some of the areas finest homes.

Metro-Adelaide land almost doesn’t exist, and if you find it – then it will be small and limiting, or the only other option is to remove an existing home – expensive! At approximately 1141sqm larger than the median land size for this suburb – land like this is Gold.
At home with the environment, the truly wonderful position speaks for itself. Secure this very rare parcel of land and make building the dream a reality!

listings.headline: An Impressive and Classical Style
description: Big on street appeal and positioned in one of the best streets in Bellevue Heights!

The local area here provides easy walking, it’s peaceful & quiet with no road noise and offers a safe and secure lifestyle amongst similar quality house-proud homes. Inside and out this home presents very well and will appeal to the growing family and also couples who love to entertain, while the flat and sunny backyard setting is a real winner!
Impressive in its construction, this beautiful home was built in 1982. Solid brick, concrete slab floors and glazed terra-cotta tiles are rare build qualities today!

The double garage underneath the home has an internal stairway entry, the split-level design zones bedrooms and living areas, while high ceilings and big bay windows are timeless features. There is a certain grandness to this home with an understated character that could be further enhanced with your own ideas over time, and from inside … the connection to the backyard setting is a beauty!

The land is a deceptive 700sqm with a wide frontage and a fabulous north-east facing backyard. It’s all flat and quite a surprise with a big terraced pergola, a bright green open lawn area, and a decent hobby-work-shed. From the garage access to the yard is through a ramped walk-way – no steps! And it’s all very private out here with good height fencing and raised boundary gardens. The aspect is near perfect where you’ll be warm with that winter sun and loving it in summer shade.

The grand formal entry has tiled flooring with French doors either side that open to superb and versatile living areas. Divided by a feature wall with a gas fire-place there is a formal lounge and relaxed family room, while on the other side there is a large formal dining room, also with gas heating, that could be used as another living area.

listings.headline: What a Place to Live!
description: The Jacaranda position is a real surprise. It is a no-through street of house-proud homes that all feel very much a part of their beautiful environment – a secluded enclave very convenient to Blackwood but where you feel far from it all.

This fabulous home lives on a sweeping corner allotment and shares a long boundary with Hakea Court – it measures 1340sqm and backs onto the natural landscape of McTaggart Reserve. Imagine coming home to peace and quiet, and looking forward to an evening walk around neighbouring streetscapes or a stroll through nature at the back gate, while at the end of the street, there is a pedestrian walkway where you can shortcut to the Sturt River Linear Reserve. This is what living in the Mitcham foothills is all about!
Tucked down off the street behind thriving native gardens, there is a feeling of intimacy and privacy as you enter this 1970 Turner Wood home – a popular builder in this mid-century period!

The owners have loved their place and as the family grew so did their family home. In 1999, they extended the main living area with a brilliant Architect designed extension, and took advantage of the space underneath the home to create a new main bedroom with a separate bathroom and a study. Altogether, there are four bedrooms and two bathrooms.

The original main is a large room with wall-to-wall built-in storage, bedroom two has robes, while bedroom three – currently used as a home-office and library, is another large room. They share a main bathroom and separate toilet, and all enjoy a delightful outlook to greenery. All windows across the front of the home have retro-fit double-glaze windows!

There will be no problems sleeping in, it’s quiet down here. The adjacent bathroom is ideal, it is virtually the ensuite, but being separate ensures the bedroom is completely private. The adjoining study-computer area is a good size and could be turned into the dream walk-in robe if its preferred.

listings.headline: With a Big Backyard and a Surprise Outlook!
description: Come and live the Glenalta lifestyle of pretty streetscapes, local reserves and where the Hawthorndene Drive position is wonderfully convenient! Getting to Blackwood, Crafers/Stirling and connecting through to the city is very easy, and love living close to our amazing Belair National Park.
This one-family-owned home was built in 1960. It presents well and invites the opportunity to introduce your own style ideas now or in time and really make it your own.

The house is sited perfectly with a slight elevation that takes full advantage of a truly beautiful north-facing backyard aspect – it has views! The backyard setting is enormous and provides the opportunity to grow with an extension and more, while the wide allotment and concrete driveway provides access to a big garage-work-shed, and if you have a need to accommodate cars, boats, caravans and toys, then this could be perfect!

Inside, high ceilings and large rooms create a sense of space throughout – and for this size of home, the floorplan is a winner! From the formal entry, a spacious living area with a feeling of openness flows nicely onto the elevated entertaining deck, while the kitchen and everyday dining area is spacious too and looks out to the backyard setting and sky-views.

The walk-through galley style kitchen filled with natural light feels like a second living area with its dedicated breakfast nook by the window – it’s a simple but modern kitchen with a dishwasher, electric ceramic cooktop, raised oven, good bench space and plenty of storage.

The three bedrooms and main bathroom are tucked away in their own wing making them private from the living areas. The retro-style bathroom is still pretty cool and there is ideally a separate toilet. The laundry is also a good size and having all the wet-areas in one spot may make future renovations very easy.

listings.headline: Invest with eyes for the future... What a wonderful Position this is!
description: Welcome to 11 Reid Avenue, a well-constructed, brick, 80’s conventional, on a concrete slab with 640sqm of highly usable land! Situated within a beautiful, flat & centrally located pocket of Aberfoyle Park… So connected to the Hub shopping precinct, walking trails, sports & recreational grounds and reserves - what an opportunity this is to create home and invest in your future!

Reid Avenue is in a wonderful & tightly held position, combined with its convenience – this flat section of Aberfoyle Park was nicely designed. A combination of generous allotment frontages, additional street width and a consistent 9-metre dwelling set-back creates a feeling of space & separation.

From the street, garden beds create privacy for the living space & front facing bedroom windows. The living room has quite comfortable dimensions, features a wall mounted air conditioning unit & flows on nicely to the kitchen and meals.

The kitchen is mostly original but well maintained & fully functional. Move in, get on with living… then with eyes on your future, you can dare to dream here! The floorplan allows you to easily reconfigure the existing kitchen… Think a large marble-look island bench or a breakfast nook under the north facing window… Oh and yes, gas is connected!

The bedroom wing is nicely separated from the living areas. Like the rest of the home - all three bedrooms have fresh white walls & ceilings, combined with professionally cleaned carpets! The main bedroom provides built-in wardrobes, a ceiling fan & a wall-mounted ac-unit.

The bathroom has been renovated over the years and still presents well. Its dimensions welcome and warrant renovating in its future, fitting both a shower and a bath quite comfortably. Important to note with 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom homes… the toilet is separate from the bathroom!

listings.headline: What a Place to Live!
description: Coreega Avenue is an exclusive enclave nestled into the foothills of the historic Carrick Hill Estate and its captivating 100-acre environment. All that Sensational Adelaide has to offer is in front of this prestigious address – 15 minutes to the city and 25 minutes to our amazing coastline.

A lifestyle here is just so convenient – the Mitcham Shopping precinct has it all, the famous Edinburgh Hotel is a treat, there is a choice of Schools; Mercedes and Scotch Colleges, Unley and Urrbrae, while being connected to the trails of Brown Hill Creek recreation park is the perfect place to stretch the legs and unwind at the end of your day.

4 Coreega Avenue is spacious and hassle-free living and a superb outdoor lifestyle. With a concrete fully-tiled in-ground pool and the ultimate entertaining area, this character home was built in 1970 and lives on a beautifully landscaped 590sqm parcel of land that takes advantage of a slightly elevated north-facing aspect! The warm winter sun will find its way to the backyard setting and poolside relaxation, and when family & friends are around, or when it’s simply a weekend at home where there is nothing to do but kick-back and relax – it has that holiday feeling! It's all quite perfect.

The original garage under-main-roof has been turned into a versatile home-studio by the current owner – with a stud-wall in front of the garage door and an internal doorway, it is a complete room. The choice is yours, enjoy it as it is, or turn it back in to a garage or workshop. A concrete driveway provides space for off-street parking, while from the street, landscaped steps provide a gentle rise to the front yard lawn area and into your home. Most front yard settings aren’t lived in, but here – it’s a nice spot to relax and complements the portico entry.

Inside really feels like home. With a peaceful energy all-of-its-own – it’s practical and simply lives well! The floorplan provides fabulous open plan living around the kitchen, and having a huge separate room where you can get away from it all is essential. High ceilings create a sense of space, it all feels fresh and vibrant with modern upgrades and the timber flooring throughout looks great!

From the entry, the open void space and the split-level design is visually appealing, and together, these features serve to zone the floorplan is an ideal way – it ensures the bedrooms are private from main living areas. This is a home that will appeal to families and couples of all ages too.

listings.headline: Spacious, Practical & Hassle-Free Living!
description: When it comes time to downsize, it can be hard to find the one that feels just right and at a fair pricing level. Especially for singles and couples, this freestanding Community Title home is an absolute delight, and it may be appealing to the investor as a much-needed rental home too.

The Community Plan is a group of six homes, three either side of a central driveway. 4 English Avenue is an attractive home that enjoys a wide street frontage of native gardens and lives on a very comfortable 392sqm allotment. A secure garage under-main-roof provides internal entry, and also handy roller door access through to the paved backyard where there is room for a trailer if needed – this feature can be hard to find.

The paved backyard patio and garden setting is just the right size without being too large or too small! It all feels very private, safe and secure, and the way the east-north sunshine finds its way inside is very welcome. That warm winter sun is everything and you’ll be relaxing in summer shade.

From the portico entrance, the entry hall also serves to separate the three bedrooms from the kitchen and living areas making them feel private. The main bedroom has a large walk-through robe to a main ensuite bathroom, separate toilet and an additional guest vanity!

Bedrooms two and three are light filled rooms that look out to the front yard gardens, they are a good size and potentially versatile too – bedroom two could be a library-home-office or even perhaps a separate TV room and the other a visiting guest room.

The main living areas combine with the kitchen in a beautiful way – they are light and bright while the overall dimensions are the size you’d hope to see. You certainly don’t feel closed-in! The kitchen is spacious with plenty of clear bench-space that comes in very handy, especially when the home chef is in full flight or when it comes time to entertain.

listings.headline: If you dare to dream...
description: This land-holding is one of the last remaining allotments in the Mitcham Hills, certainly in Belair!
Building a home just for you is all about location and position first.
If you have a desire to live free in a peaceful environment with exceptional views – and be so connected to everything, this is it!

11 Bond Road is a section of land at the end of a secluded enclave, it measures 2147sqm (0.53acre), and feels like a private National Park. It is sloping land with natural terraces and takes in a west-north aspect and views forever! Walking to where a new home may be sited, picture being elevated looking through treetops to the valley that surrounds Centre Way below, to the airport, the lights of the Adelaide plains and all the way to Gulf St Vincent.

Secure this dream position, and then design and build to-the-land. Land like this invites the journey to truly vision a home designed and built just for you. A one-of-a-kind home that will be yours for a lifetime and a legacy to this wonderful parcel of land.
A great example of how to truly capitalise on this block is next door!

listings.headline: A Family Floorplan with Huge Outdoor Living!
description: If there is a need for that bit of extra space, then this great buying opportunity has it – with four bedrooms and three living areas or potentially 5 bedrooms, this floorplan is a winner!
Move in and settle down, then plan to improve with your own ideas over time – there is loads of potential to complement this home inside and out!

The flat land measures 729sqm and provides a surprising amount of yard space in both front and backyards. The backyard aspect faces east-north, it’s private and has great lawn space for kids and the family-hound to play till their heart’s content.

At 86sqm, the covered outdoor entertaining area is huge! Year-round outdoor living, barbeque, lounging, table-tennis or even to store the camper-trailer – it really does feel like an extension to the home, and being open to the double-length remote carport, it’s handy to have front-to-backyard access!

The brick veneer and tiled roof home was built in 1981, and later extended to provide more space for the growing family and where all bedrooms feel private from main living areas. The large main bedroom lives at the back of the home with French doors that open to an intimate alfresco – it has a walk-in-robe and an updated ensuite.

Bedroom two is a versatile and almost hidden room – it has built-in storage and is complemented by a lounge-retreat, also with French doors to the alfresco. And just an idea: if this bedroom is not required, remove the stud-wall between the two and turn it into a brilliant games room.

listings.headline: A Secluded and Natural Valley Setting – 1707sqm!
description: 3 bedrooms / 1 bathroom / 2 undercover cars + / outdoor living + huge games room

Come and live the metro-foothills lifestyle where you can retreat to a peaceful environment, and be so connected – our amazing coastline is 15-minutes and getting to the city is easy. You can even walk to the Flinders train station, and the exciting north-south corridor project is happening!

This well-presented home is invitingly different and with a few unique features – underneath the home a huge studio-style games room is a real surprise with many potential uses, and a superb all-season outdoor entertaining area is the place to be!

Private from street view, the home is sited at the end of a long bitumen driveway on the low side of the street. It was built in 1977, and elevated to take advantage of a north-easterly aspect looking over a natural landscape of adjoining properties, also on large allotments.

The 1707sqm of land (0.42 acre), is deceptively low maintenance and being a natural park-like setting, it’s just there and changes with the seasons. Think of coming home at the end of your day, to peace & quiet, birdlife, and that feeling of disconnect in your very own environment.

At the bottom of the drive to the side of the home, a large double length carport with excellent height was previously used to accommodate a caravan - there is plenty of room to turn around and for guest parking. In and out is very easy!

listings.headline: Quite Possibly Blackwood Park’s Finest
description: 4 bedrooms / 4.5 bathrooms / home-office / 4 huge living areas / 2 car garage

From the moment you step inside, there is a calming opulence and an admiration for refined quality that is absolute. It is extremely spacious and lives with a certain practicality often forsaken in grand homes, and with no neighbours behind, there is a sense of freedom with amazing views across Blackwood Park. You will be surprised!

The home itself is packed with added features and valuable inclusions will be offered with the sale. In every respect it is complete and wants for nothing! Living here is where everyday living, weekends at home and entertaining will be nothing other than sheer pleasure. Imagine building a new home like this today? Finding land with views, investing the time in planning and design, and then actually building it – it is a huge undertaking.

On settlement day, one fortunate buyer will feel like they are receiving the keys to a new-build bespoken just for you, for this luxurious home is in immaculate presentation! A perfect representation of the undeniable Samuel James quality – it was built in 2018 and the land measures 1105sqm. 47 Fergusson Avenue presents an incredible buying opportunity to secure the true forever home, one where you can simply move in and get on with living.

Think of coming home at the end of your day to a peaceful recluse with grazing kangaroos and the joy of open space reserve beyond the back fence. Take a walk through a stand of majestic gums down to the lake and enjoy the benefits of the Farm’s nature walks – the centrally convenient position is simply ideal.

Modern and contemporary with almost a Mediterranean influence in style, the wide stance and impressive front façade has a timeless appeal. A wide aggregate concrete driveway provides easy access to a large double garage with internal entry to your home, and with the building being tucked down off the street, there is a feeling of intimacy and privacy as you enter the home.
